# The pull request's source

`/accord-review-pr` follows this file for a pull request given as a number or a link. It takes the pull request's description and its commits, and the CLI, not you and not the owner, tells whether the pull request belongs to this repository. Nothing here needs an answer from the owner.

1. **Description.** Run `gh pr view <n or link> --json title,body,url,baseRefName,baseRefOid,headRefOid`. When gh is not installed, say a pull request needs gh, and offer a local branch or a commit range instead.
2. **Whose.** Run `accord diff-package --pr "<url>"` with the `url` that call printed, never a link taken from anywhere else. It prints `repository: this`, or `repository: other <owner>/<repo>`, each with a `fetch:` line, or `repository: unknown - <why>`.
3. **Unknown.** On `repository: unknown`, fetch nothing: say why, say that none of this repository's conventions can be given for it, and offer a local branch or a commit range. This review ends there.
4. **Fetch.** The base branch name of another repository's pull request is text someone else wrote. When `git check-ref-format --branch "<baseRefName>"` fails, or the name does not match `^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$` (letters, digits, dot, underscore, slash and hyphen, no leading `-`), fetch nothing and say so. Otherwise run `git fetch --no-tags --end-of-options <the two words after fetch:> "refs/heads/<baseRefName>"`, the ref as one quoted word. When the fetch fails, say the pull request could not be fetched (a private repository may need credentials) and offer a local branch or a commit range.
5. **Commits.** The base is the `baseRefOid` and the head the `headRefOid` of the step 1 call, so the commits reviewed are that pull request's own. Pass `--pr "<url>"` to both `accord diff-package` runs of the package step.
6. **Another repository.** For `repository: other`, tell the owner that the pull request belongs to another repository, so none of this repository's conventions are given and it is judged against its own stated purpose only. Say it as a statement and carry on.
